sentences.text: As per allegations made in the FIR which was lodged by victim herself, it is alleged that on 14.02.2024 at 10 O'clock in night, she had come out of the house to respond the call of nature.
Her husband was not at the house.
At the same time, Vikas Chouhan who is her neighbour came and he caught hold of her and took her inside the house and after having closed the door of the house raped her.
On the pointing of knife he also criminally intimidated her not to disclose the incident.
4. The date of occurrence is of 14.02.2024 and this FIR was lodged on 20.02.2024.

Though the victim in her statement under section 164 of Cr.PC also reiterated the averment made in the FIR, yet taking into consideration inordinate delay in lodging the FIR, the bail application of the applicant is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.
